name: Medicare price negotiation
summary: Negotiation starts 7 years after approval (small molecule) or 11 (biologic).

name: Most Favored Nation pricing
summary: US prices tied to reference countries (GLOBE, GUARD).
trigger: >$100M Part B / $69M Part D spend, in-scope class
implication: US net price falls toward benchmarks.

name: EU Joint Clinical Assessment
summary: EU-wide clinical assessment alongside EMA approval.
trigger: New oncology substances & ATMPs (now); orphan (2028); all (2030)
implication: Evidence package drives HTA outcome and timing.

name: EU General Pharmaceutical Legislation
summary: Extra protection for unmet need, comparative trials, new indications.
implication: Protection varies with evidence and supply.
